sources.title: A new basis for Hamiltonian SU(2) simulations
sources.authors: Christian W. Bauer, Irian D'Andrea, Marat Freytsis and Dorota M. Grabowska
sources.reading_depth: PDF introduction, selected Sec. II definitions, Sec. IV one-plaquette reduction and radial equations, Appendix B Mathieu solution, opening Appendix C gauge-fixing discussion
sources.used_for: Independent source match for four-link Casimir factor, conjugation constraint, Haar radial transform and exact even-order Mathieu characteristic values
sources.limitations: Fetched PDF identifies v1; newer publisher version metadata was inspected but not line-matched in full. One-plaquette solution is established prior work, and its continuum-time spectrum is not a four-dimensional continuum construction.

sources.title: Simulating Fully Gauge-Fixed SU(2) Hamiltonian Dynamics on Digital Quantum Computers
sources.authors: Henry Froland, Dorota M. Grabowska and Zhiyao Li

sources.limitations: Displayed HTML metadata contains a v1 identifier with a later manuscript date; record both without conflating dates. Hardware results, resource estimates and complete two-plaquette implementation were not reproduced here.

sources.title: Truncation uncertainties for accurate quantum simulations of lattice gauge theories

sources.limitations: Examples are U(1) and Schwinger-model oriented. No factorial SU(2) error constant imported from this paper; project form inequalities are derived separately.
